title: Fix VS Code Copilot Chat Native Hooks
prompt: VS Code hooks are not calling semio-repo hooks. Need to fix the hook output format to produce VS Code-compatible JSON, extract tool_name from stdin, and use proper hookSpecificOutput with permissionDecision for PreToolUse events.
summary: Fixed 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading hookSpecificOutput)' in VS Code Copilot Chat v0.37.6. Root cause: formatVSCodeHookOutput returned {} for UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse/Stop/SubagentStop/PreCompact events. VS Code _toHookResult strips continue/stopReason/systemMessage leaving empty object → output=undefined. The UserPromptSubmit onSuccess callback accesses d.hookSpecificOutput without null-checking d. Fix: always include hookSpecificOutput for all VS Code hook events. Updated tests. All hook tests pass.

interactions.prompt: VS Code Copilot Chat hook UserPromptSubmit crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading hookSpecificOutput)'. Root cause: formatVSCodeHookOutput returns {} for UserPromptSubmit/PreCompact/Stop events. VS Code Copilot v0.37.6 _toHookResult strips continue/stopReason/systemMessage fields, leaving empty object, sets output=undefined. Then UserPromptSubmit onSuccess callback does d.hookSpecificOutput?.additionalContext without null-checking d, causing TypeError. Fix: always include hookSpecificOutput for all VS Code hook events.
